name: xixi-blog
description: 曦曦的博客 —— 书房 × 工坊 × 旅程

scripts.postbuild: pagefind --site dist/client --output-path dist/client/pagefind && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),dst='.vercel/output/static/pagefind';if(fs.existsSync('.vercel/output')){fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('dist/client/pagefind',dst,{recursive:true});console.log('[postbuild] pagefind → .vercel/output/static')}else{console.log('[postbuild] no .vercel dir, skip copy')}"
